inputs.label: Virtua Cop 2 arcade ROM set (MAME vcop2)
inputs.help: Your own MAME vcop2.zip. Leave it zipped.

inputs.label: Billboard firmware (segabill.zip)
inputs.help: Your own segabill.zip. Not needed if your vcop2.zip already holds all 31 required files. Leave it zipped.

steps.why: The app reads the ROM sets from Download. The guide has the user allow game-file access on the first start.

steps.text: Open Virtua Cop 2 VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it. The app checks the ROM sets and enters VR when they pass.

notes: This is the vr4all-standalone build (Model 2A on patched MAME), not a Port0r game, so no tag filter is needed. segabill.zip is optional because a vcop2.zip with all 31 payloads also works. The guide says "allow game-file access" without naming the permission; All files access is assumed. Releases also carry vcop2-vr-pcvr.zip and vcop2-vr-source.zip.
